# Coding Prompt — Complete "Base Web" Landing Page **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build a complete, production-quality **Landing Page for the Base Web design system** in a **single first attempt**. The theme is **Base Web** (Uber's open-source design system): highly themeable primitives, neutral and functional, mobility-app roots, strong theming tokens, accessible components, flat-platform aesthetic, era 2018–present. Elevation comes from subtle shadows; the theme's ONE signature trait is the **"seam"** — a solid 3px underline in the current theme color (`--seam`) that marks active/focus state (nav active link, input bottom border, primary button bottom accent), never used as decoration. **Source note (translated):** *"The source spec does not declare color modes; validate in light and dark before publishing."* Dark mode is therefore yours to design and must be validated in both modes before you declare completion. --- ## 0. Strict Architecture Rules **1.1 CSS-First & Zero Inline CSS** * All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden anywhere in the HTML**. * Target all design properties, layout, and states exclusively via class/ID selectors (BEM). * `script.js` must never mutate inline styles — every state change is a class toggle or ARIA attribute change. HTML stays semantic, clean, and style-agnostic: re-theming must require CSS edits only. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** * In addition to the baseline tokens above, `:root` **must** define the mandatory system tokens — they may alias theme tokens to avoid duplication: `--primary` (= `#276ef1`), `--secondary` (= `--color-accent`), `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary` (= `--color-surface-strong`), `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary` (= `--color-text-muted`), `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`, `--radius-sm/md/lg`, `--shadow-sm/md`, `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast` (150ms), `--transition-normal` (300ms), `--ease-standard`, `--z-dropdown` (1000), `--z-modal` (2000), `--z-toast` (3000). Every component rule consumes variables — never raw values. * Success/error colors: pick a green (may derive from the accent) and a distinct red harmonious with the neutral palette, each passing WCAG AA against both surfaces in **both** modes. * **Contrast pairing:** every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token pairs with a light text token — enforced in every theme, including dark mode and the swatch demo variants. * Light backgrounds: the default rule requires `#fefefe` instead of pure white — **Exception:** the Base Web spec explicitly declares `#ffffff` for `--color-bg`/`--color-surface`, so those exact values are permitted. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode** * Dark mode is **mandatory**. Define dark tokens (e.g., bg `#121212`, surface `#17171a`, surface-strong `#1f1f24`, border `#383838`, text `#ffffff`, muted `#9b9b9b`; lighten primary/accent for contrast, e.g., `#4d84f3` / `#0fd06f` — tune until AA passes). * Implement via a `.dark`/`[data-theme="dark"]` class on `` **and** an `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` fallback for first visit, both consuming one shared token block — theme switching must not touch HTML structure. * A visible header **toggle button** with a Material `dark_mode`/`light_mode` icon, correct `aria-pressed` and dynamic `aria-label`; choice persists via `localStorage` (e.g., key `baseweb-theme`), falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; apply the stored theme synchronously at the top of `script.js` to minimize flash. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First** * Build all layout with Flexbox. **Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`**; any exception (e.g., stretched pricing cards, top-aligned text blocks) requires a CSS comment justifying it. * Mobile-first: rows become columns under ~768px via flex-direction/wrap; **zero horizontal scrolling down to 320px**; minimum touch target 44×44px. **1.5 Framework & Naming Convention** * Primary styling = the theme's custom CSS class system in `style.css` (baseline classes above, extended). Tailwind CSS is permitted for layout utilities only; every utility/design value must map back to a CSS variable or a reusable class (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`). No other libraries. * **One convention only: BEM** (`block__element--modifier`, e.g., `.btn--primary`, `.card__title`, `.pricing__tier--featured`, `.faq__item`). Never mix conventions. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** * Load Google Fonts via ``: **Inter** for text (and **Roboto Mono** for code). Bind `--font-sans`/`--font-display` to `'Uber Move', 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif` and `--font-mono` to `'Uber Mono', 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace`. **Exception:** Uber Move / Uber Mono are not distributed on Google Fonts, so the Google-hosted fonts render where they are absent — load no fonts from any other source. * Icons: **Google Material Symbols** (outlined, single ``), e.g., `check_circle`. **No inline SVGs, no emoji icons, no local icon files.** --- ## 2.
